SysDataModelXML.SQLScript:
--LINKMYROWDATA --LINKDETAILLIST(KEEWAYZUP4510X,700,{0},{1}) DECLARE @LANX3 VARCHAR(30) = '#LINKFUNC.GETLANX3#'; DECLARE @FCY VARCHAR(10)='{0}'; DECLARE @MFGNUM VARCHAR(30)='{1}'; DECLARE @ITMREF NVARCHAR(100)=N'%{2}%'; DECLARE @ITMDES NVARCHAR(100)=N'%{3}%';
SELECT MAT.MFGFCY_0 AS 地点 ,MAT.MFGNUM_0 AS 工单号 ,MAT.MFGLIN_0 AS 行号 ,MAT.BOMSEQ_0 AS 物料顺序 ,MAT.ITMREF_0 AS 物料编码 -- ,ITM.ITMDES1_0 + ITM.ITMDES2_0 + ITM.ITMDES3_0 AS 物料名称 ,ISNULL(L1.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES1_0) AS 物料描述1 ,ISNULL(L2.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES2_0) AS 物料描述2 ,MAT.STU_0 AS 单位 ,Cast(MAT.RETQTY_0 AS REAL) AS 需求数量 ,Cast(MAT.USEQTY_0 AS REAL) AS 已消耗数量 ,Cast(Isnull(XWS.QTY, 0) AS REAL) AS 未提交数 ,Cast(MAT.RETQTY_0 - MAT.USEQTY_0 - Isnull(XWS.QTY, 0) AS REAL) AS 剩余数量 ,MAT.LOC_0 AS 库位 ,CASE WHEN Isnull(XWS.QTY, 0) > 0 THEN 'E02' WHEN MAT.RETQTY_0 - MAT.USEQTY_0 > 0 AND MAT.USEQTY_0 > 0 THEN 'A02' WHEN MAT.RETQTY_0 - MAT.USEQTY_0 <= 0 THEN 'H02' ELSE 'B01' END AS ROW_BACKCOLOR2 ,CASE WHEN Isnull(XWS.QTY, 0) = 0 AND MAT.USEQTY_0 = 0 THEN N'lang:{zh:未消耗,en:None,de:Keine}' WHEN MAT.RETQTY_0 - MAT.USEQTY_0 > 0 AND MAT.USEQTY_0 > 0 THEN N'lang:{zh:部分消耗,en:Part,de:Teil}' WHEN MAT.RETQTY_0 - MAT.USEQTY_0 <= 0 THEN N'lang:{zh:全部消耗,en:All,de:Alle}' END AS 消耗状态 ,MAT.MFGNUM_0 + Cast(MAT.MFGLIN_0 AS VARCHAR) + Cast(MAT.BOMSEQ_0 AS VARCHAR) id ,CASE WHEN ITM.LOTMGTCOD_0 > 1 THEN N'lang:{zh:批次号管理,en:Batch Management,de:Chargenverwaltung}' ELSE '' END LOTFLG ,CASE WHEN SERMGTCOD_0 >1 THEN N'lang:{zh:序列号管理,en:Serial Number Management,de:Seriennummernverwaltung}' ELSE '' END SERFLG FROM MFGMAT MAT INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON MAT.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN ITMLAN1 L1 ON L1.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND L1.LANX3 = @LANX3 LEFT JOIN ITMLAN2 L2 ON L2.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND L2.LANX3 = @LANX3 LEFT JOIN (SELECT MFGNUM_0 ,MFGLIN_0 ,BOMSEQ_0 ,Sum(USEQTY_0) QTY FROM XWSMKM WHERE RPFLG_0 <> 3 GROUP BY MFGNUM_0 ,MFGLIN_0 ,BOMSEQ_0)XWS ON XWS.MFGNUM_0 = MAT.MFGNUM_0 AND XWS.MFGLIN_0 = MAT.MFGLIN_0 AND XWS.BOMSEQ_0 = MAT.BOMSEQ_0 WHERE MAT.MATSTA_0 IN ( 1, 2 ) AND MAT.MFGFCY_0 = @FCY AND MAT.MFGNUM_0 = @MFGNUM AND ITM.ITMREF_0 LIKE @ITMREF AND Cast(MAT.RETQTY_0 AS REAL) > 0 AND Upper(ISNULL(L1.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES1_0) + ISNULL(L2.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES2_0)) LIKE Upper(@ITMDES) ORDER BY XWS.QTY DESC
